label: Identity
description: Who a directory said a credential belongs to: a stable subject, a display name, the groups it belongs to, and -- when verify was given a `type` -- whatever else the directory said about the account, under `attributes`. The same whatever the directory, so one sign-in graph fits them all.

attributes.description: Whatever the directory said about the account beside its subject, name and groups. `$I` is the variable `verify` binds from its `type` param: unknown unless the port that returns this shape binds it, so a sign-in that named a shape reads its fields and one that did not forwards the value whole.
